NSH::service_index
Description
This command gets/sets the service index for NSH.
Syntax
NSH
::
service_index
(
DIRECTION
NSH_SERVICE_IDX
)
?
Examples
Set the service index for NSH.
when LB_SELECTED {

NSH::service_index serverside_egress 20

set myservice_index [NSH::service_index]

}
